name: HAPSENG
recent: Hap Seng 宣布2026财年第二次中期股息每股10仙，并公布季度业绩。公司正通过子公司处置其在 Hafary Holdings 的50.82%股权，总现金代价约1.4003亿新元，该收购要约已成为无条件。此外，公司就 Platinum Park 土地收购的條件期限延长六个月。
notable: 宣布2026财年第二次中期股息每股10仙。
拟处置 Hafary Holdings 50.82%股权，总现金代价约1.4003亿新元，收购要约已成为无条件。
Platinum Park 土地收购的條件期限延长六个月至2027年3月22日。

recent_en: Hap Seng declared a second interim dividend of 10 sen per share for FY2026 and released its quarterly results. The company is disposing of its 50.82% stake in Hafary Holdings via a subsidiary for a total cash consideration of approximately SGD140.03 million, with the offer having become unconditional. It also extended the conditional period for the Platinum Park land acquisition by six months.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 10 sen per share for FY2026.
Proposed disposal of 50.82% stake in Hafary Holdings for total cash consideration of approximately SGD140.03 million; the offer has become unconditional.
Extended the conditional period for the Platinum Park land acquisition by six months to 22 March 2027.
